title: Monte Carlo prediction on the random walk
brief: Estimate state values by averaging the returns that followed each state in complete episodes, first-visit and every-visit, and check them against the exact values of the random walk.
hints: For first-visit estimates, make a fresh empty set at the start of each episode and skip a state once it is in the set.
Keep two arrays, total[s] and count[s]. Add the return G[t] to total[s] and 1 to count[s] each time a visit counts, then divide at the end.
Divide with np.divide(total, count, out=np.zeros(n_states), where=count > 0) so states that no episode visits stay at 0.
